prompt: A portrait board leaning against a pale plaster wall on a light oak floor, a small stack of hardback books resting against its lower left corner and a ceramic vase to its right, soft afternoon light. The board's face is one solid panel of vivid emerald green. Straight-on frontal photograph, the panel rectangular and square to the camera, its surface one unbroken sheet of flat matte vivid emerald green paint, the same colour edge to edge, ending exactly at the panel's own outline. Natural daylight rakes across the whole scene. Photographic, 50mm, sharp, minimal styling.
